# Approved shared rig: ten performances

Ten user-approved performances share one rig: EXP-163/005/001/006/107/007/002/152/160/177. Revised EXP-177 Meditative calm adds a single continuous 1.2-second closing arc, with unchanged hold/opening keys from 1.2 seconds onward. All nine prior profiles, gaze_down_extra, rigid outer-anchor brow controls, automatic-blink restoration, runtime and all 182 PNGs remain exact. EXP-003/164 and all other unregistered drafts remain excluded. See MEDITATIVE_PUBLICATION_VALIDATION.md for approval, source identities and verification. Earlier explicitly marked checkpoint descriptions below are historical provenance. The EXP-177 publication profile changes only its status text; every other reviewed field and motion value is exact.

Historical EXP-160 checkpoint: nine user-approved performances shared one rig: EXP-163/005/001/006/107/007/002/152/160. The published002/152 profiles, hidden-iris support and gaze_down_extra semantics are preserved. EXP-160 adds the approved default-zero rigid outer-anchor brow capability without new artwork. EXP-003/177/161/153 remain excluded. See SHY_MERGED_PUBLICATION_VALIDATION.md for merged scope and evidence; preceding frozen review stages are historical.

Historical EXP-152 checkpoint: eight user-approved performances shared one rig: EXP-163/005/001/006/107/007/002/152. EXP-002 is preserved from published commit 9b10e2f2c70f19fa003169502a73ee935af55480; EXP-152 includes the approved hidden-iris/down-gaze prerequisite. EXP-003/160/177 and new brow channels are excluded. See MERGED_PUBLICATION_VALIDATION.md for exact scope, source identities and focused merge checks. Earlier stage descriptions and frozen review receipts are historical.

EXP-152 uses nine source-proposed anchors across 1.9 seconds: downward preparation, restrained closed smile, then mouth-neutral while gaze recovers. No runtime, art, head/body or FX changes are added by the performance. It requires the separately tested optional gaze_down_extra channel, default zero, adding 5 source pixels to the original gaze_y mapping. Old-profile commands and appearance remain protected. Normal-speed playback observation is not claimed.

# Ryoko shared expression rig

**Current publication status: user-approved.** All ten performances and their published prerequisites are approved; the containing commit establishes publication.

One assembled separate-part character, one bounded performance controller, and data-only expression definitions. The default Godot application shows **one rig**. EXP-163 (Yawn), EXP-005 (Hearty laughter), EXP-001 (Bright welcome), EXP-006 (Suppressed giggle), EXP-107 (Confident reassurance), EXP-007 (Relieved smile), EXP-002 (Affectionate warmth), and EXP-152 (Private pride), EXP-160 (Shy laughter), and EXP-177 (Meditative calm) are authored and registered. All ten and their published prerequisites are user-approved; the old expression catalogue and emotion sheets are references, not implemented performances.

## Run

Open `project.godot` in Godot 4.6.3 and run. Select the registered performance and press Play (P), Release (Space), or Reset (0). Sliders provide bounded manual controls. Manual input takes ownership and cancels active playback/release. The optional auto-blink defaults off. When enabled, it pauses during performances and resumes after exact neutral recovery. The viewer reports actual activity separately from the saved preference; changing it is manual takeover. See AUTO_BLINK_VALIDATION.md for this independently reviewed focused correction and its verification limits.

`expression_viewer.tscn` is the default app. `yawn_stage.tscn` is a separate legacy three-view review scene, not another runtime architecture. It delegates to the same player through a thin compatibility wrapper.

## Local external control

To let a separate local process control this same rig, launch with
`godot --path . -- --control-port=18163`, then run
`python tools/ryoko_control_client.py --port 18163 --demo` in another terminal.
The bridge is off by default and binds only 127.0.0.1. Manual UI actions revoke
external writes until explicitly re-enabled. See `LOCAL_CONTROL_BRIDGE.md` for
the exact protocol, trust boundary, lifecycle, error handling and real-process tests.
No AI model or TTS service is connected by this phase.

## Architecture

- `object_face.gd`, `object_rig.gd`, shaders and native artwork: separate-part assembly; the backbone migration preserved it and the later bounded-gaze phase adds explicit derived eye owners.
- `expression_registry.gd` and `expressions/registry.json`: transactional validation and supported-ID discovery.
- `expression_rig.gd/.tscn`: one timeline sampler/player, control validator and ownership lifecycle.
- `expression_viewer.gd/.tscn`: one-rig app using that public API.
- `control_bridge.gd` and `strict_control_json.gd`: optional bounded loopback adapter to the very same rig, not another controller.
- `yawn_performance.json`: unchanged 13-key, 5.8-second yawn data, registered as EXP-163 with alias `yawn`.
- `expressions/EXP-005.json`: the 15-key, 5.4-second hearty-laughter performance, using generic smile-eye/lip channels and the existing player. See `SMILE_VALIDATION.md` for the historical laughter review.
- `expressions/EXP-001.json`: the approved nine-key, 3.0-second bright welcome. Separate rigid lateral lip/oral owners broaden the smile. See `WELCOME_SCOPE_VALIDATION.md`.
- `expressions/EXP-006.json`: a 13-key, 2.8-second pressed smile, small escaped laugh and re-press. Two closed-smile controls and separately registered original cheek-blush FX use the same shared controller. Published and user-approved at `4f3deaa2de3eedb691a9f0c795c7b8563663e472`. See `GIGGLE_SCOPE_VALIDATION.md`.
- `source_references/expression_catalogue_93.json`: preserves all 93 historical IDs as references; only the ten actual authored performances are playable.
- `yawn_rig.gd`: only legacy names, labels and the Y shortcut. It delegates sampling, playback, validation and ownership to the generic player.

Future performances add validated JSON plus a registry entry. Any missing movement capability must be implemented generically with separate rigid owners; performances do not add a controller subclass or a new application. See `CONTROL_API.md` for the shared callable contract and schema.

## Preserved appearance and motion

The native 1136×1384 approved bust supplies the visible head, face, nose, jaw, neck, hair, eyes and brows. Only fixed whole-rig presentation transforms are used. Independent moving owners retain unit local scale and full opacity.

Existing parts include four rigid hair regions with seam guards; independent brows; upper lashes, lower contours, irises, sclerae and closed lashes; fuller neutral lips; and continuous cavity, upper/lower lips, upper/lower teeth, tongue and static underlip shadow. Foreground hair ownership and the stationary connected neck/body remain intact.

Normalized `mouth_open` 0–1 maps to physical aperture 0–0.55: at most 30.8 source-pixel cavity height and 29.7-pixel lower-lip travel. Upper teeth stay attached at (533,626). This EXP-007 extension preserves all 182 parent PNGs and all five approved performance definitions byte-for-byte. The historical lateral-mouth extension added seventeen source-derived PNGs for separate cavity, posterior enamel, tongue and explicitly inferred joint-underlap support. The fixed central white teeth remain unchanged.

There is no face/UV warp, animated feature scale, full-face patch or emotion opacity crossfade. Interpolation changes control coordinates, not image opacity.

## Honest limits

- Existing normalized gaze remains [-1,1] per axis, with left/right 4, up 2 and down 1 source pixels. The local, separately reviewable `gaze_down_extra` channel adds 0–5 downward source pixels, for total down 6, without recalibrating old commands. It uses only newly completed hidden iris strips. See DOWN_GAZE_VALIDATION.md; this generic capability is user-approved as the prerequisite for EXP-152. GAZE_VALIDATION.md preserves the original gaze-stage history.
- Hair is limited to ±0.07; wider travel needs additional hidden artwork.
- Non-neutral A/E/I/O/U and their viseme aliases are rejected by the public app/controller. The historical lower-level `object_rig` still exposes them for compatibility diagnostics and is **not** a safe app/AI entry point.
- Earrings remain static. Full-body motion, the other 86 catalogue expressions, lip-sync/phoneme authoring and AI-model/voice-service integration are not implemented. An opt-in local external-process control bridge is available; it does not itself connect a model or TTS provider.
- Flattened-source crossings contain the existing documented hidden-skin, hair-seam and continuation estimates. They are not claimed to be original clean artwork.

## Historical scoped EXP-006 publication

This extension is based on the published EXP-001 source at `69e74ce5049a13ad5aa33014cacb1287f494787a`. All 174 parent PNGs and the three existing performance definitions remain byte-identical. Rigid closed-smile corner curvature and inferred inner-upper-lip pressure add only the required mouth support. This is a reference-matched separate-object performance, not a pixel-identical repaint. Wide-eye and oral-lift capabilities, held EXP-003/007, and AI/TTS integration remain excluded. ## Published EXP-107 extension

This extension starts from the exact approved EXP-006 commit `4f3deaa2de3eedb691a9f0c795c7b8563663e472`. It preserves all 182 PNGs and four prior profiles byte-for-byte, adds no artwork, and introduces only the shared normalized `mouth_oral_lift` channel. EXP-107 uses eleven keys across 3.0 seconds: a closed reassuring smile, one modest open accent, a closed lingering smile and neutral return. Direct gaze, fixed head/body/hair and separate rigid owners remain unchanged.

The exact nine-panel source sheet, panel hashes and proposed reference timing are documented in `source_references/EXP-107_reference_metadata.json`. The reference is not a pixel-identical target for the different approved canonical artwork. See `REASSURANCE_SCOPE_VALIDATION.md` for the complete scope, current verification and honest limits. Run `python tools/verify_reassurance_scope.py`, the two historical scoped guards and the applicable runtime suites in `REASSURANCE_SCOPE_VALIDATION.md`. Source diagnostics must be rebuilt only in an isolated copy.

## Approved EXP-007 extension

This expression and generic rigid-purse extension starts from approved EXP-107 commit `35a7ddc615e7501a9a814ca02d722ddb40f200c9`. It preserves all 182 PNGs and five prior profiles byte-for-byte. A generic bounded mouth_purse channel adds inward rigid lip articulation through the existing shared controller, viewer and preparation-only bridge. It adds no artwork. EXP-007 is relieved smile, not teasing grin: inward worried tension, parted exhale, open smile, closed lingering smile and exact neutral.

The new nine-key 3.2-second timeline interprets the original static sheet, whose 1.9-second timing was a proposal. Slight ordinary-lid lowering keeps eyes open; no laughing-eye substitution or additional FX. Fixed canonical artwork means the brow hook and upper-lip bow are approximations. The reference's BOD-037 shoulder/hand action is excluded. See `RELIEF_SCOPE_VALIDATION.md` and exact source metadata in `source_references/EXP-007_reference_metadata.json`. EXP-007 is user-approved for publication. `RELEASE.json` records current approval status. Frozen review receipts and descriptive profile metadata retain their historical wording; the reviewed runtime, artwork, profile values and timing are unchanged.

Only 155 left and 132 right hidden RGB texels change. All iris alpha, observed pigment/highlights, old continuous gaze footprint, stationary sclera, shaders and foreground hair remain exact. extends SceneTree
## Deterministic shared-controller and UI/adapter tests; no listening socket.
var rig
var checks=0
var failures=[]
const IDS=["EXP-163","EXP-005","EXP-001","EXP-006","EXP-107","EXP-007","EXP-002","EXP-152","EXP-160","EXP-177"]
func _initialize():call_deferred("run")
func check(ok,label):
    checks+=1
    if not ok:
        failures.append(label)
        if failures.size()<30:push_error(label)
func state():
    var s=rig.get_state();s.erase("last_error");s.elapsed=rig.elapsed;s.face=rig.face.snapshot()
    return s
func pending(wanted,label):
    check(not rig.auto_blink and rig.auto_blink_pending_restore==wanted,label+" actual suspended and intent preserved")
    var s=rig.get_state()
    check(s.auto_blink==rig.auto_blink and s.auto_blink_pending_restore==wanted,label+" honest state")
func neutral(wanted,label):
    check(rig.active_performance=="" and rig.release_time<0,label+" neutral ownership")
    check(rig.pose_now()==rig.neutral_pose() and rig.displayed_pose()==rig.neutral_pose(),label+" exact open neutral")
    check(rig.auto_blink==wanted and not rig.auto_blink_pending_restore,label+" restoration consumed once")
    for joint in rig.face.smile_eye_joints:check(not rig.face.objects[joint.key].visible,label+" no smiling lash owner")
    check(rig.face.oral_objects.upper_teeth.position==Vector2(533,626),label+" fixed white enamel")
func begin(id,wanted):
    rig.reset();rig.apply_controls({"auto_blink":wanted});rig.advance(4.03)
    var before=rig.displayed_pose()
    check(rig.play_expression(id),"play "+id)
    check(rig.displayed_pose()==before,"trigger C0 "+id)
    pending(wanted,id)
func blink_cycle(wanted,label):
    # The restored clock starts at 0; these are the unchanged base timing points.
    if wanted:check(rig.elapsed==0.0,label+" open-phase clock restart")
    rig.advance(3.86);check(rig.face.closure==Vector2.ZERO,label+" existing open interval")
    rig.advance(.085);check(is_equal_approx(rig.face.closure.x,sin(PI*.25) if wanted else 0.0),label+" closing")
    rig.advance(.085);check(is_equal_approx(rig.face.closure.x,1.0 if wanted else 0.0),label+" fully closed")
    rig.advance(.085);check(is_equal_approx(rig.face.closure.x,sin(PI*.75) if wanted else 0.0),label+" reopening")
    rig.advance(.085);check(rig.face.closure.length()<.000001,label+" fully reopened")
    for joint in rig.face.smile_eye_joints:check(not rig.face.objects[joint.key].visible,label+" no retained laughter family")
func run():
    rig=load("res://expression_rig.tscn").instantiate();root.add_child(rig);rig.set_process(false)
    check(rig.rig_ready and rig.registry_ready,"ready")
    if not rig.rig_ready or not rig.registry_ready:quit(2);return
    neutral(false,"default remains disabled")
    for wanted in [false,true]:
        for id in IDS:
            for ending in ["completion","release","repeated_release","zero_delta"]:
                begin(id,wanted)
                var duration=rig.registry.definition(id).duration
                if ending=="completion":
                    rig.advance(duration-.000001);pending(wanted,id+" before completion")
                    rig.advance(.0000011)
                elif ending=="zero_delta":
                    var before=rig.displayed_pose();rig.advance(0.0)
                    check(rig.displayed_pose()==before and rig.performance_time==0.0 and rig.active_performance==id,"zero delta keeps pose, clock and owner")
                    pending(wanted,"zero delta keeps restore intent")
                    rig.play_expression(id);pending(wanted,"zero-duration retrigger")
                    rig.release();rig.release();rig.advance(0.0);pending(wanted,"zero-duration releases")
                    check(rig.release_time==0,"zero elapsed remains release");rig.advance(.45)
                else:
                    rig.advance(.6);var before=rig.displayed_pose();rig.release()
                    check(rig.displayed_pose()==before,"release C0");pending(wanted,"release")
                    check(rig.active_performance=="" and rig.release_time==0,"empty active_expression is not recovery completion")
                    rig.advance(.2);pending(wanted,"partial recovery")
                    if ending=="repeated_release":
                        before=rig.displayed_pose();rig.release();check(before==rig.displayed_pose(),"repeat release C0")
                        rig.advance(.449999);pending(wanted,"repeat release not prematurely restored");rig.advance(.0000011)
                    else:rig.advance(.25)
                neutral(wanted,id+" "+ending);blink_cycle(wanted,id+" "+ending)
            # All cross-profile handoffs and a retrigger inside interrupted release.
            for target in IDS:
                begin(id,wanted);rig.advance(.6);rig.release();rig.advance(.2)
                var before=rig.displayed_pose();rig.play_expression(target)
                check(rig.displayed_pose()==before,"cross-profile release handoff C0")
                pending(wanted,"cross-profile saved intent")
                rig.advance(.15);rig.play_expression(target);pending(wanted,"retrigger saved intent")
                rig.advance(rig.registry.definition(target).duration);neutral(wanted,"cross-profile finish")
    for mode in ["performance","release"]:
        for command in [{"auto_blink":false},{"reset":true},{"mouth_open":.2},{"blink":.4},{"auto_blink":true},{"reset":true,"auto_blink":true},{"reset":false,"mouth_open":.1}]:
            begin("EXP-005",true);rig.advance(.6)
            if mode=="release":rig.release();rig.advance(.1)
            check(rig.apply_controls(command),"manual command accepted")
            check(rig.active_performance=="" and rig.release_time<0 and not rig.auto_blink_pending_restore,"manual cancels pending even for false-to-false")
            var expected=command.get("auto_blink",false)
            check(rig.auto_blink==expected,"manual actual setting")
            var pose=rig.pose_now();rig.advance(20)
            check(rig.pose_now()==pose and rig.auto_blink==expected and not rig.auto_blink_pending_restore,"no stale deferred restoration")
            # New performance must capture the latest setting, not old deferred intent.
            rig.play_expression("EXP-007");rig.advance(3.2);neutral(expected,"latest preference after manual action")
        begin("EXP-005",true);rig.advance(.7)
        if mode=="release":rig.release();rig.advance(.1)
        var before=state()
        for command in [{},{"reset":false},{"release_performance":false}]:
            check(rig.apply_controls(command),"genuine no-op");check(state()==before,"no-op preserves pending")
        for command in [{"auto_blink":false,"mouth_open":2},{"auto_blink":1},{"perform_expression":"absent"},{"reset":true,"unknown":1}]:
            check(not rig.apply_controls(command),"invalid rejected");check(state()==before,"invalid atomic including pending")
        for delta in [-1,NAN,INF]:
            check(not rig.advance(delta),"invalid advance rejected");check(state()==before,"invalid time preserves pending")
        rig.sample_expression("EXP-005",1);rig.get_state();rig.list_expressions();rig.auto_blink_policy()
        check(state()==before,"read-only calls preserve intent")
        # No timer can finish a paused rig. Engine frames do not advance set_process(false).
        for i in range(3):await process_frame
        check(state()==before,"paused processing cannot resurrect blink")
        rig.advance(20);neutral(true,"explicit deterministic resume")
    # Release directly from idle also captures the preference and displayed blink.
    for wanted in [false,true]:
        rig.reset();rig.apply_controls({"auto_blink":wanted});rig.advance(4.03)
        var before=rig.displayed_pose();rig.release();check(before==rig.displayed_pose(),"idle release C0")
        pending(wanted,"idle release");rig.advance(.45);neutral(wanted,"idle release completion")
    # Exact floating-point threshold, not a neutral-looking sampled pose, owns restore.
    begin("EXP-007",true);rig.advance(.6);rig.release();rig.advance(.15);rig.advance(.30)
    pending(true,"split release below threshold");check(rig.release_time<rig.RELEASE_SECONDS,"rounding remains below threshold")
    rig.advance(rig.RELEASE_SECONDS-rig.release_time);neutral(true,"exact remaining release")
    var viewer=load("res://expression_viewer.tscn").instantiate();root.add_child(viewer);viewer.set_process(false);viewer.rig.set_process(false)
    viewer.apply_controls({"auto_blink":true});viewer.play_selected();viewer._process(0)
    check(viewer.auto_blink_button.button_pressed and not viewer.rig.auto_blink,"UI preference checked while actual paused")
    check("paused" in viewer.auto_blink_status.text and "neutral recovery" in viewer.auto_blink_status.text,"UI explains suspension")
    viewer.auto_blink_button.button_pressed=false

extends SceneTree
## Shared-coordinate transport only. Geometry and source ownership have separate tests.
const AXIS="mouth_purse"
const PRIOR_IDS=["EXP-163","EXP-005","EXP-001","EXP-006","EXP-107"]
var rig
var checks=0
var failures=[]
func _initialize():call_deferred("run")
func check(ok:bool,label:String):
    checks+=1
    if not ok:
        if failures.size()<20:push_error("PURSE_TRANSPORT "+label)
        failures.append(label)
func state()->Dictionary:
    var s=rig.get_state();s.erase("last_error")
    s.current=rig.current_pose.duplicate(true)
    s.restart=rig.restart_pose.duplicate(true)
    s.release=rig.release_pose.duplicate(true)
    s.performance=rig.performance.duplicate(true)
    s.elapsed=rig.elapsed
    s.oral_mode=rig.oral_mode
    s.manual_mouth_purse=rig.manual_mouth_purse
    return s
func coordinate(value:float,label:String):
    var s=rig.get_state()
    check(rig.pose_now()[AXIS]==value and rig.displayed_pose()[AXIS]==value,label+" pose/display")
    check(s.controls[AXIS]==value and s.displayed_controls[AXIS]==value,label+" public state")
    check(rig.current_pose[AXIS]==value and rig.manual_mouth_purse==value,label+" current/manual")
    check(rig.face.mouth_purse==value,label+" face parameter")
func run():
    rig=load("res://expression_rig.tscn").instantiate();root.add_child(rig);rig.set_process(false)
    check(rig.rig_ready and rig.registry_ready,"rig ready")
    if not rig.rig_ready or not rig.registry_ready:quit(2);return
    check(rig.neutral_pose()[AXIS]==0.0,"neutral contains zero coordinate")
    coordinate(0.0,"initial default")
    check(rig.Registry.CHANNEL_BOUNDS[AXIS]==[0.0,1.0],"registry bounds")
    var bridge=load("res://control_bridge.gd").new();bridge.rig=rig
    var caps=bridge.capabilities();bridge.free()
    check(caps.controls[AXIS]==[0.0,1.0],"bridge bounds")
    check(caps.lip_purse=={"control":AXIS,"default":0.0,"scope":"bounded shared control"},"bridge generic coordinate only")
    check(not caps.ai_model_connected and not caps.tts_connected,"preparation-only integration")
    check(rig.registry.resolve("relief")=="EXP-007" and rig.registry.resolve("relieved-smile")=="EXP-007","authored relief aliases")
    check(rig.list_expressions().size()==10 and rig.registry.resolve("EXP-003")=="","nine approved performances")

    for value in [0.0,.000001,.25,.5,.75,.999999,1.0,0.0]:
        check(rig.apply_controls({AXIS:value}),"valid bounded coordinate")
        coordinate(value,"manual value")
    # An omitted coordinate in older data is an exact zero, never inherited.
    for id in PRIOR_IDS:
        var definition=rig.registry.definition(id)
        for frame in definition.keyframes:check(not frame.values.has(AXIS),"prior authored data has no purse "+id)
        for hz in [30,60]:
            rig.reset();rig.play_expression(id)
            for i in range(int(ceil(definition.duration*hz))+1):
                var t=minf(float(i)/hz,definition.duration)
                check(rig.sample_expression(id,t)[AXIS]==0.0,"prior sample defaults zero "+id)
                coordinate(0.0,"prior playback "+id)
                rig.advance(1.0/hz)
    var omitted=rig.neutral_pose();omitted.erase(AXIS)
    rig.apply_controls({AXIS:.9});rig._apply_performance_pose(omitted)
    coordinate(0.0,"omitted applied pose defaults zero")
    rig.reset()

    # Reject the whole transaction before any ownership, clock or state changes.
    for mode in ["neutral","manual","active","release"]:
        rig.reset()
        if mode!="neutral":rig.apply_controls({AXIS:.73,"mouth_open":.2})
        if mode in ["active","release"]:rig.play_expression("EXP-007");rig.advance(.1)
        if mode=="release":rig.release();rig.advance(.07)
        for invalid in [-.000001,1.000001,NAN,INF,-INF,true,false,"1",null,{},[]]:
            var before=state()
            check(not rig.apply_controls({"reset":true,"mouth_open":.7,AXIS:invalid}),"invalid coordinate rejected in "+mode)
            check(state()==before,"invalid coordinate atomic in "+mode)
        for bad in [{AXIS:.6,"blink":true},{AXIS:.6,"unknown":0},{AXIS:.6,"perform_expression":"EXP-007"},{AXIS:.6,"release_performance":true}]:
            var before=state()
            check(not rig.apply_controls(bad),"mixed invalid transaction rejected")
            check(state()==before,"mixed invalid transaction atomic")
        for noop in [{},{"reset":false},{"release_performance":false}]:
            var before=state()
            check(rig.apply_controls(noop),"no-op accepted")
            check(state()==before,"no-op retains coordinate and ownership")

    # Trigger, interruption, retrigger, handover, manual takeover and return use
    # the same coordinate as all other channels, never expression-specific code.
    for entry in rig.list_expressions():
        rig.reset();rig.apply_controls({AXIS:.82,"mouth_open":.3})
        var before=rig.displayed_pose()
        check(rig.play_expression(entry.id),"trigger "+entry.id)
        check(rig.displayed_pose()==before and rig.restart_pose[AXIS]==.82,"trigger C0 and restart coordinate")
        rig.advance(.1);before=rig.displayed_pose()
        rig.play_expression(entry.id)
        check(rig.displayed_pose()==before,"retrigger C0")
        rig.advance(.05);before=rig.displayed_pose()
        rig.release()
        check(rig.displayed_pose()==before and rig.release_pose[AXIS]==before[AXIS],"release C0 and saved coordinate")
        rig.advance(.1);before=rig.displayed_pose()
        rig.play_expression(entry.id)
        check(rig.displayed_pose()==before,"interrupted release C0")
        rig.advance(.05)
        for destination in rig.list_expressions():
            before=rig.displayed_pose();rig.play_expression(destination.id)
            check(rig.displayed_pose()==before,"cross-expression C0")
            rig.advance(.02)
        rig.apply_controls({AXIS:.35})
        check(rig.active_performance=="" and rig.release_time<0 and rig.face.owners.mouth=="manual","manual purse owns pose")
        rig.advance(.7);coordinate(.35,"manual persists without stale resume")
        rig.release();rig.advance(rig.RELEASE_SECONDS)
        coordinate(0.0,"release exact zero")
        check(rig.displayed_pose()==rig.neutral_pose(),"release exact neutral")
        rig.apply_controls({AXIS:1.0});rig.play_expression(entry.id);rig.advance(entry.duration)
        coordinate(0.0,"completion exact zero")
        check(rig.displayed_pose()==rig.neutral_pose(),"completion exact neutral")
        rig.apply_controls({AXIS:.67});rig.reset();coordinate(0.0,"reset exact zero")
        check(rig.restart_pose.is_empty() and rig.release_pose.is_empty() and rig.performance.is_empty(),"reset clears saved lifecycle")

    # Test-only in-memory profile; never added to the shipping catalogue.
    var fixture={"id":"TEST-PURSE","title":"Transport fixture","duration":1.0,"keyframes":[{"time":0.0,"phase":"neutral","values":{}},{"time":.5,"phase":"purse","values":{AXIS:1.0}},{"time":1.0,"phase":"neutral","values":{}}]}
    check(rig.registry.validate_definition(fixture,fixture.id),"timeline accepts coordinate")
    check(rig._sample(fixture,.25)[AXIS]==.5 and rig._sample(fixture,.5)[AXIS]==1.0,"shared smooth interpolation")
    check(rig._sample(fixture,0)[AXIS]==0.0 and rig._sample(fixture,1)[AXIS]==0.0,"timeline endpoints exact zero")
    var isolated=rig.Registry.new()
    var catalogue={"schema_version":1,"entries":[{"id":fixture.id,"path":"res://test-only-purse.json"}]}
    check(isolated.load_catalogue(catalogue,{"res://test-only-purse.json":fixture}),"isolated profile accepted")
    var held=isolated.definition(fixture.id)
    for invalid in [-.000001,1.000001,NAN,INF,-INF,true,false,"1",null,{},[]]:
        var bad=fixture.duplicate(true);bad.keyframes[1].values[AXIS]=invalid
        check(not isolated.load_catalogue(catalogue,{"res://test-only-purse.json":bad}),"invalid timeline rejected")
        check(isolated.definition(fixture.id)==held,"registry failure atomic")
    check(rig.registry.resolve(fixture.id)=="" and rig.list_expressions().size()==10,"fixture remains unregistered")

    # Exercise the actual UI signal and display synchronization, without a socket.
    var viewer=load("res://expression_viewer.tscn").instantiate();root.add_child(viewer)
    viewer.set_process(false);viewer.rig.set_process(false)
    check(viewer.sliders.has(AXIS),"viewer slider present")
    var slider=viewer.sliders[AXIS]
    check(slider.min_value==0.0 and slider.max_value==1.0,"viewer slider bounds")
    viewer.rig.play_expression("EXP-007");viewer.rig.advance(.6)
    slider.value=.321
    check(is_equal_approx(viewer.rig.pose_now()[AXIS],.321) and viewer.rig.active_performance=="","slider manual takeover")
    check(not viewer.control_bridge.external_enabled,"slider does not enable external control")
    viewer.rig.apply_controls({AXIS:.654});viewer._process(0)
    check(is_equal_approx(slider.value,.654),"viewer reflects displayed coordinate")
    viewer.apply_controls({"reset":true});viewer._process(0)
    check(slider.value==0.0,"viewer reset synchronized")
    viewer.free()
    print("PURSE_TRANSPORT checks=",checks," failures=",failures.size())
    quit(1 if failures.size() else 0)
